# Quick Pool Services

**Website:** https://quickpoolservices.co.za

**Business Name:** Quick Pool Services

**Industry:** Swimming Pool Construction, Repairs, Renovations & Maintenance

**Location:** Gauteng, South Africa

**Phone:** 074 555 1054

**Email:** info@quickpoolservices.co.za

---

# About Quick Pool Services

Quick Pool Services is a trusted swimming pool contractor serving residential and commercial clients throughout Gauteng, South Africa.

With years of hands-on experience, we specialise in designing, constructing, repairing, renovating and maintaining swimming pools of every size. Our mission is to deliver quality workmanship, honest advice and dependable service while ensuring every customer enjoys a clean, safe and beautiful swimming pool.

Our motto is:

> **Experience is the Best Teacher**

---

# Our Services

## Swimming Pool Construction

We design and build custom swimming pools to suit every property and budget.

Services include:

- Custom pool design
- Fibreglass pool installation
- New swimming pool construction
- Above-ground pools
- Luxury residential pools
- Commercial pools

---

## Pool Renovations

We restore old and damaged pools to like-new condition.

Renovation services include:

- Pool remodelling
- Pool reshaping
- Pool resurfacing
- Marbelite replacement
- Mosaic tiling
- Coping replacement
- Waterline tile replacement

---

## Pool Cleaning

Professional cleaning services include:

- Vacuuming
- Brushing walls
- Skimming debris
- Chemical balancing
- Water testing
- Algae treatment
- Green pool recovery

---

## Pool Maintenance

Regular maintenance helps prevent costly repairs.

Maintenance includes:

- Weekly pool servicing
- Monthly servicing
- Equipment inspections
- Chemical checks
- Filter cleaning
- Pump inspections

---

## Pool Repairs

We diagnose and repair swimming pool problems including:

- Pump repairs
- Pump replacement
- Filter repairs
- Multiport valve replacement
- Sand filter repairs
- PVC pipe repairs
- Suction leaks
- Pressure leaks
- Pool plumbing repairs

---

## Leak Detection

We locate and repair leaks using professional diagnostic methods.

Common leak symptoms include:

- Constant water loss
- Air bubbles
- Low suction
- Wet areas around pool
- Equipment losing prime

---

## Pool Equipment Installation

We install:

- Pool pumps
- Sand filters
- Cartridge filters
- Salt chlorinators
- Heat pumps
- Pool lights
- LED lighting
- Timers
- Automatic controllers

---

## Pool Heating

Heating options include:

- Heat pumps
- Solar heating systems
- Energy-efficient solutions

---

## Water Features

Construction and repairs of:

- Waterfalls
- Fountains
- Deck jets
- Water blades

---

## Koi Ponds

Services include:

- Pond construction
- Pond filtration
- Pump installation
- Leak repairs
- Cleaning
- Maintenance

---

## Jacuzzi Services

We install and repair:

- Jacuzzi pumps
- Jets
- Filters
- Pipework
- Heating systems

---

# Frequently Asked Questions

## Do you build new pools?

Yes. We construct custom swimming pools from start to finish.

## Do you repair pool pumps?

Yes. We repair and replace most major pool pump brands.

## Can you fix swimming pool leaks?

Yes. We specialise in leak detection and leak repairs.

## Do you replace filter sand?

Yes. We replace old filter media to improve water quality and circulation.

## Do you install pool lights?

Yes. We install and replace LED pool lighting systems.

## Do you service commercial pools?

Yes. We provide maintenance for both residential and commercial properties.

## Do you provide regular maintenance?

Yes. Weekly and monthly maintenance plans are available.
